reuse.why: The new field calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same helper every server and client consumer uses for the expected amount.

duplication.why: No logic is repeated; the expected-amount rule is not re-derived.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API schedule shape is built.

scope.why: A two-line change plus the type field, nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Easy to own, with minor nits: the #shared import sits after the relative imports, and expectedAmount is added to APIScheduleEntity, which also types create/update input where it means nothing.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the rule is delegated to the shared helper.
